claims: The UConn Huskies won the 2025 NCAA Division I women's basketball championship.
The UConn Huskies defeated the South Carolina Gamecocks 82–59 on April 6, 2025, in Tampa, Florida.
UConn's victory marked UConn's 12th national championship.
UConn's 12th national championship broke the tie with the UCLA men's team for the most in college basketball history.
South Carolina entered the championship as a No. 1 seed.
The game was a rematch of the 2022 championship game.
UConn secured their first title since 2016
